items.t: AOC stumps for Angie Nixon in Central Florida before election day
items.x: U.S. House Rep. Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez (D-NY), arguably one of the most high-profile politicians in the country, joined Florida’s U.S. Senate candidate Angie Nixon for a “Boricuas for Angie” rally in Kissimmee Tuesday night to highlight…

items.t: Horror con Spooky Empire happens in Orlando over Halloween weekend
items.x: Horror con Spooky Empire, much like a good slasher-flick villain, is back for another installment in Orlando on Halloween weekend.

items.t: Court suggests Florida teacher shouldn’t be punished for celebrating Charlie Kirk’s death
items.x: A Florida judge last week recommended dismissing a misconduct case against a Clay County teacher for a post celebrating Kirk's death.

items.t: Uthmeier says property risk-assessment company ‘is marketing fear to advance a climate activism agenda’
items.x: Florida has sued a company that issues climate change assessments of property risks including flooding that the state alleges are deceptive

items.t: Genitorturers make Halloween heavy in Orlando
items.x: Cult legends the Genitorturers are returning to their birthplace of Orlando to punish us so good again with their BDSM rock spectacle.

items.t: Orlando PlayFest opens this weekend with bold new dramatic works
items.x: If you’re all spooky season’d out and instead want to spend Halloween taking in some terrifyingly good new theatrical works, the first weekend of PlayFest is where you need to be. You’ll be treated to staged readings of six plays and get…

items.t: Scottish comic Daniel Sloss comes to Steinmetz Hall
items.x: Feeling bitter about living in the shadow of imminent economic collapse? Scottish comedian Daniel Sloss might just commiserate onstage at Steinmetz Hall Friday. He’s taking his new show, Bitter — a hit at the Edinburgh Fringe Festival, so…

items.t: Organist Cameron Carpenter conjures symphony of horror to soundtrack ‘Nosferatu’
items.x: Between the haunting shadows of Murnau’s Nosferatu and Carpenter’s esoteric accompaniment, this silent film promises to make plenty of noise.

items.t: The Nook celebrates its last night open with a Halloween funeral party
items.x: The Nook on Robinson is closing on Halloween night and, fittingly for a space that has never shied away from a good conceptual soiree, with a funeral-themed party.

items.t: Orlando musicians dress up as their fav bands for Halloween cover shows
items.x: The local institution that is Psycho ’78 doing their annual full-bore Misfits set is always welcome; a GG Allin tribute act called GG Ellin has us intrigued despite ourselves; and hardcore firebrands M.A.C.E. doing a Bauhaus (!) tribute…

items.t: Man in custody after 2 shot, killed in Ocala, police say
items.x: A man was taken into custody after two other men were fatally shot Wednesday in Ocala, according to police.

items.t: Earl the Squirrel will make a giant balloon debut at Macy’s parade
items.x: Universal Orlando's Earl the Squirrel is set to join the Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade on Nov. 26 in New York City.

items.t: ‘I made a terrible mistake:’ Fishback apologizes after wrongly accusing Florida GOP candidate of sex trafficking probe
items.x: Over two months after wrongly claiming that Florida gubernatorial candidate Byron Donalds was under federal investigation, ex-competitor James Fishback has now issued an apology.

items.t: Utah charges Kalshi and its founders, escalating a fight over who can regulate prediction markets
items.x: Utah is pursuing criminal charges against prediction market operator Kalshi and two executives, after a federal judge rejected Kalshi’s effort to prevent Utah from enforcing its anti-gambling laws against the activity.

items.t: Judge denies federal request to segregate California ballots, says it would 'wreak havoc' on voting
items.x: A federal judge has rejected a Trump administration request to stop California from processing the ballots of up to 20,000 people, warning it would “wreak havoc” on the midterm elections.

items.t: 'A serious problem': Lake County to sue over foul smell
items.x: Some residents in Mount Dora — particularly in the Sullivan Ranch area — have complained about a foul smell they say has affected their community for years.

items.t: From Apollo’s largest moon rock to Artemis III’s first stack — America’s lunar return accelerates
items.x: NASA integrated the core stage of its Artemis III rocket with its twin solid rocket boosters Wednesday at Kennedy Space Center in Florida, advancing preparations for a mission to test spacecraft docking systems before future lunar landings.

items.t: US and Japan, long alarmed by China's aggression, agree to establish missile-production facility
items.x: The United States and Japan have agreed to establish a Japanese facility for the joint production of advanced medium-range air-to-air missiles, the Japanese defense chief said.

items.t: Two men killed, one arrested in Ocala shooting, police announce
items.x: Upon arrival, police found the two men with gunshot wounds; one died at the scene inside a nearby home, and the other was taken to the hospital, where he succumbed to his injuries, officials explained.

items.t: Trooper airlifted after truck rams into patrol car
